risks.risk: Exact engine type/model is not readable, so the item may not match the comparable engines (wrong engine family/fitment).
risks.proof: Ask for a clear close-up photo of the engine code/plate (e.g., stamped code on block) and the full label/ID on the engine.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the worst-case comparable (treat as generic/possibly incomplete or wrong-match engine) using the cheapest matching listing.

risks.risk: May be incomplete (missing turbo, sensors, manifolds, wiring harness, ECU, starter/alternator) or not truly a complete engine.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo checklist: show every major component laid out (turbo, alternator, starter, intake manifold, exhaust manifold, sensors, ECU/loom if included) and confirm what is included/excluded in text.
risks.if_unproven: Assume missing parts / not fully complete and price at the lowest comparable.

risks.risk: “Tested and working / no knock” cannot be verified remotely; could have internal damage or noise.
risks.proof: Ask for a short video of the engine running (cold start if possible) plus a sound check, or a diagnostic scan screenshot.
risks.if_unproven: Assume not proven working and price at the lowest comparable.

risks.risk: “Low mileage / never opened” cannot be verified; could be high mileage or previously rebuilt.
risks.proof: Ask for odometer/engine mileage evidence (if available) and close-ups of seals/fasteners to show no tampering.
risks.if_unproven: Assume unknown condition and price at the lowest comparable.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the engine code/ID plate stamped on the engine block (and any label showing model/variant).
Confirm whether it is a complete engine or which parts are missing (ECU, turbo, manifolds, starter/alternator, wiring harness, sensors).
Video proof: engine start/run showing no knock (and ideally a diagnostic scan screenshot).
Close-up photos of seals/gaskets/fasteners to support “never opened.”
response.reason: The photo does not show any readable engine identity (engine code/model) and there is no proof of testing/working status, so a confident worst-case price match to the comparables is not possible without the decisive engine identification and inclusion details.
